subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers replace the conflicting fork repair with a narrow schema-only PR, adopt and rebase that fork branch, or intentionally retire the documented global key?
rationale: The fix shape is clear, but an open fork PR already claims the exact closing fix while being conflicting, not maintainer-editable, and mixed with stale daemon changes; automation should not create a duplicate without maintainer direction.

options.title: Open narrow replacement
options.body: Create or sponsor a schema-only repair that preserves the useful config fix and drops the unrelated daemon/systemd changes.

options.title: Adopt and rebase fork
options.body: Use the open fork branch only if a maintainer can rebase it, make it editable, and remove stale non-schema changes before review.

options.title: Retire the global key
options.body: If the global knob is no longer desired, remove it from docs/help/types/runtime reads instead of accepting it in the schema.

recommendation.title: Open narrow replacement
recommendation.body: Create or sponsor a schema-only repair that preserves the useful config fix and drops the unrelated daemon/systemd changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the documented config behavior and are the strongest history signal for deciding whether to preserve or retire this config surface.
